# Lyriix Android 0.2.0 — first public beta

- Synced lyrics with line and word highlighting, a fading trail, tap-to-seek, and automatic following. Scroll manually to pause following, or tap Follow lyrics.
- Downloaded songs keep the PC's lyrics for offline playback. Plain lyrics and instrumental tracks have their own display.
- A visible Lyrics button on the player.
- Persistent download progress, per-song percentages, byte totals, queue states, cancellation, and retries.
- Profiles use the PC app's layout, avatar, role badge, favorite songs and albums, recent tracks, statistics, privacy settings, profile editing, browsing, and friends. Profile music remains view-only.
- Automatic beta update checks and in-app APK downloads. Updates verify the checksum, version, package, and signing key; Android confirms installation.

Requires Lyriix Windows 0.11.20 or later for synced lyrics. Use the same account and pair over Wi-Fi with the PC address and six-digit PIN.

This first public APK uses the permanent release signing key. Android cannot install it over an earlier private debug APK signed with a different key. If Android reports a signature conflict, uninstall that private preview first, install the public beta, and reconnect the PC. Later public beta updates install over this version and retain data.
